title: HIV Viral Load and Resistance Testing Standard Operating Procedures
author: Julie Denison
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bcc7iszn

steps.title: Instrument Set-up
steps.instruction: Initialize the software and perform required instrument maintenance.

substeps.instruction: Turn on the Data Station for the AMPLILINK software.
Log onto the Windows XP operating system.
Launch the AMPLILINK software and log in with the assigned User ID and password.
Check the PG WR supply via the Status Screen and replace if necessary.
Perform all maintenance listed in the Due Tab of the COBAS AmpliPrep and Cobas TaqMan instruments (refer to PCRL-TECH-020 and PCRL-TECH-021).

steps.title: Load Reagent Cassettes
steps.instruction: Prepare and load the HIV-1 test reagents onto the COBAS AmpliPrep instrument.

substeps.instruction: Remove reagents from 2-8°C storage and load onto the COBAS AmpliPrep instrument, allowing them to equilibrate to ambient temperature for at least 30 minutes before processing the first sample.
Place HIV-1 CS1 on a reagent rack and load into rack position A.
Place HIV-1 CS2, HIV-1 CS3, and HIV-1 CS4 on a separate reagent rack and load into rack position B, C, D, or E.

steps.title: Load Disposables and K-carriers
steps.instruction: Load the necessary consumables and carriers into the instruments.

substeps.instruction: Determine the required number of reagent cassettes, SPUs, S-tubes, K-tips, and K-tubes.
Load SPUs in the SPU rack(s) into rack position J, K, or L of the COBAS AmpliPrep instrument.
Load full K-tube rack(s) into rack position M, N, O, or P of the COBAS AmpliPrep instrument.
Load full K-tip rack(s) into rack position M, N, O, or P of the COBAS AmpliPrep instrument.
Load K-carriers on pack positions 5-12 of the Cobas TaqMan instrument.

steps.title: Prepare and Load Specimens
steps.instruction: Prepare the sample racks, create software orders, and load specimens and controls.

substeps.instruction: Attach barcode label clips to sample rack positions for each specimen (S-tube) and specific barcode label clips for controls [CTM (–) C, HIV-1 L(+)C, and HIV-1 H(+)C].
Place one Input S-tube into each position containing a barcode label clip.
Create specimen and control orders in the AMPLILINK software Orders Window Sample folder using test file HICAP96 and save.
Assign orders to sample rack positions in the Orders Window Sample Rack folder and print the Sample Rack Order report.
Vortex each specimen and control [CTM (–) C, HIV-1 L(+)C, and HIV-1 H(+)C] for 3 to 5 seconds.

Transfer 1000 to 1100 μL of each specimen and control to the appropriate barcode labeled Input S-tube using a micropipettor with an aerosol barrier or positive displacement RNase-free tip, ensuring no particulates or fibrin clots are transferred.
Transfer specimens and controls to assigned tube positions and record on the worksheet, avoiding contamination of the upper part of the S-tubes.
Load the sample rack(s) onto rack positions F, G, or H of the COBAS AmpliPrep instrument.
Open the AmpliPrep Systems window and click the 'Start' button in the System folder.

steps.title: Post-AmpliPrep Processing
steps.instruction: Finalize the AmpliPrep run and prepare for transfer to the analyzer.

substeps.instruction: Check for flags or error messages.
Remove processed samples and controls from the COBAS AmpliPrep instrument.
Remove waste from the COBAS AmpliPrep instrument.

steps.title: Amplification and Detection
steps.instruction: Load processed samples into the COBAS TaqMan Analyzer for amplification.

substeps.instruction: Load K-carrier racks containing processed controls/samples and working Master Mix onto the COBAS TaqMan Analyzer within 120 minutes after processing.
Ensure processed samples and controls are not exposed to light and are NOT frozen or stored at 2-8°C.

steps.title: Finalize Run and Report Results
steps.instruction: Complete the analyzer run and process the data.

substeps.instruction: Print the Results Report upon completion and check for flags or error messages.
Store accepted data in the archive.
Remove used K-tubes from the COBAS TaqMan Analyzer.

steps.title: Waste Disposal
steps.instruction: Dispose of biohazardous materials according to safety protocols.

substeps.instruction: Discard used SPUs and S-tubes into a plastic biohazard bag, seal, and secure.
Empty the waste reservoir into a sink, flush thoroughly with water, and rinse the reservoir.
Remove, seal, and secure the K-Tube waste container from the Cobas Taqman analyzer.
Place a biohazard bag into a labeled waste bin.
Autoclave waste bags at 121ºC for 1 hour prior to incineration.
